hotkeys.text: Open Settings and choose Hotkeys. Click the shortcut field and press your combination. Tap starts dictation on the first press and stops it on the second. Hold records until you release the shortcut. Voice Assistant, Translation and Meeting Mode have separate shortcuts.

microphone.text: Choose an input device in Settings, then speak and check the meter. If the device is missing or access was denied, check your operating system's audio input and permission settings. A saved device selection does not test the microphone.

models.text: In Settings, Speech to Text has separate selections for Dictation, Note Recording and Audio Upload. Local uses a model downloaded to this computer. Self-hosted uses the server you configure. Language Model has separate model selections for cleanup, assistant and chat. The speech model only turns audio into text.

meetings.text: A meeting recording uses the microphone and, where enabled, system audio. Select the speech recognition engine under Note Recording and check the input devices and permissions before recording.

calendar.text: Meeting recording works directly from the notes interface on this device. Choose the input devices required to capture the meeting.

language.text: The interface language controls the menus. Transcription language controls recognition. Translation has a separate target language and shortcut.

backup.text: Notes, settings and history are stored on your computer. Use the project documentation to locate the profile for manual backups. Installed models have their own cache, and can be downloaded again independently.

assistant.text: Choose a local language model or an explicit self-hosted endpoint in Settings. Local models with tool support can work with your notes and dictionary. Tone and Style works with supported cleanup models. For settings questions, the assistant can read a limited set of saved settings and show this bundled guide.
